title: Frontend bundle budgets
description: Per-route first-load JS budgets enforced by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs.

tolerance.description: Fractional headroom allowed above maxBytes before a route fails (0.05 = 5%).

route.description: App Router route, normalised as bundle-budget.mjs reports it (e.g. "/", "/pay").

maxBytes.description: Maximum first-load JS in bytes, before tolerance is applied.
